If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast is flat, add 0.5–1.0% upward bias for late horizon (16–30 days).  
When sentiment spikes to 1.00 after a downward trend, shift forecast upward by 2–3% for next 3–5 days.  
If sentiment is 0.67 and forecast exceeds true value by >3%, apply downward correction of 2–4% for next 5–7 days.  
If sentiment is 0.33 and true price is rising faster than forecast, add 1–2% upward bias for next 7–10 days.
